A.claim: Of 405 reduced signatures with exponents in {3,4,5,7,11,13,17,19,23} and x<=y, this project can cite a recorded result for only 40. The remaining 365 are signatures THIS PROJECT cannot justify - not signatures that are open in the literature.

B.claim: The congruence conditions at coprime moduli are positively CORRELATED as constraints, not independent: f(m1*m2) < f(m1)*f(m2) in every measured case, with ratios 0.749-0.889 for two factors and 0.500-0.560 for three.
